standing: Source-linked author assessments and byte-preservation guards; not independent fidelity proof.

before.hash_boundary: Exact UTF-8 bytes from the heading start through the line before the next same-or-higher-level heading, including this heading, separator and terminal newlines.

current.hash_boundary: Exact UTF-8 bytes from the heading start through the line before the next same-or-higher-level heading, including this heading, separator and terminal newlines.

cases.name: Governance truth
cases.instance: No strategy ownership; publish state, pressure or route eligibility.
cases.reason: The original lawful list remains exact.

cases.name: Unowned repair direction
cases.instance: No strategy ownership; prescribe how the downstream actor repairs.
cases.reason: The first unlawful form remains exact; F2/F4/F6 explain its boundary.

cases.name: Ratified strategy role
cases.instance: Strategy ownership explicitly belongs to ratified responsibility, with the actual grant.
cases.reason: The original opening exception remains exact and the argument expressly preserves it.

cases.name: Owned assessment
cases.instance: Budgets, scores or ratings assess the actor within an explicitly owned assessment boundary.
cases.reason: The existing assessment exception remains exact; the argument does not require additional strategy ratification.

cases.name: Unowned replacement assessment
cases.instance: Budgets, scores or ratings recreate another actor’s judgment without ownership of that assessment boundary.
cases.reason: The original conditional prohibition remains exact.

cases.name: Hidden doctrine
cases.instance: A governance-only prompt, projection or route helper becomes replacement strategy doctrine.
cases.reason: The original hidden-doctrine and replacement-engine clauses remain exact.

cases.name: Optional profile boundary
cases.instance: A system has not adopted the applicable DMM profile or does not trigger this boundary relation.
cases.reason: The source governing relation and account applicability remain unchanged; the local argument selects no universal responsibility configuration.
